newsitem.title: UK: M.A.I.D. up after firm soothes market nerves.
newsitem.headline: M.A.I.D. up after firm soothes market nerves.

text.p: Shares in M.A.I.D. Plc rallied on Wednesday amid a positive response to a statement from the company on Tuesday that trading was in line with expectations and it knew no reason for recent share falls, traders said.
The stock was 20p higher at 192-1/2 by 1217 GMT, extending yesterday's 23p advance.
"It's bounced on the back of that (the announcement) and there is buying interest today," one trader said.

Shares in M.A.I.D. fell to a four month low of 150p on Monday after a steady decline since October 1995. But the company said it was aware of no reason for the fall and that revenues continued to rise.
